title: Calendar
seriesHint: You are editing the entire series, not just this occurrence.
instanceHint: You are editing this occurrence of the series.
participantHint: Existing attendees are preserved. Manage attendee lists and invitations with your calendar provider. Changes may trigger notifications there.
name: Name
caldavHint: Enter your provider's CalDAV or calendar home URL. Discovered calendars are added automatically.
icsHint: Subscriptions refresh regularly and are read-only. A private ICS URL grants access to your calendar; keep it confidential.
oauthHint: You will be redirected to the provider to authorize calendar access. Your webmail sign-in stays in place.
oauthSetup: Choose “Connect calendar” to enter your OAuth credentials here.
oauthFormHint: Enter the credentials of your registered web application, then authorize calendar access with the provider. Obtain the client ID and client secret from its developer console.
oauthSecretSaved: Saved · leave blank to keep it
oauthTenant: Directory / tenant ID (common for personal and work accounts)
oauthCallbackHint: Register this complete address as a redirect URI for your OAuth client in the developer console. Click to select and copy.
oauthOtherAddress: You can save the configuration now. Then open webmail at this address, sign in there and connect the calendar:
oauthPrivacy: The client secret is encrypted for this mailbox on the server and is never returned to the browser.
oauthSaveConnect: Save and sign in with provider
renameHint: Name and color apply to the display in this webmail.
transferHint: Import an ICS file into a local calendar or export its full contents. Existing event IDs are skipped during import.
confirmEvent: Permanently delete this event? External events will also be deleted at the provider.
confirmSeries: Permanently delete the entire event series?
confirmCalendar: Permanently delete this local calendar and all its events?
confirmDisconnect: Remove this connection and all its calendars from webmail? Events at the provider will remain.

errors.dates: Choose a valid time range. The end must be after the start. Check daylight-saving transitions as well.
errors.url: Enter a valid HTTPS calendar URL without embedded credentials.
errors.privateHost: This address belongs to a private network. The operator can explicitly allow internal CalDAV servers (see CALENDAR.md).
errors.redirect: The service redirects to another address. Enter the final calendar URL.
errors.timeout: The calendar service did not respond in time.
errors.tooLarge: The calendar is too large or contains an excessively large recurring series.
errors.remote: The calendar service is unavailable or returned an invalid response.
errors.remoteAuth: The calendar service refused access. Check your credentials or reconnect the account.
errors.conflict: The event has changed. Refresh the calendar and reopen the event.
errors.notFound: The calendar or event was not found.
errors.ics: The file is not a valid iCalendar containing complete events.
errors.recurrence: This recurrence rule is not supported.
errors.noCalendars: No suitable calendars were found at this address.
errors.oauthConfig: Enter a client ID and client secret. A changed client ID also requires a new secret.
errors.oauthAddress: Google requires an HTTPS domain address; an ordinary IP address cannot be used as a redirect URI. Enter the webmail address without an extra path. HTTP with localhost is supported for local testing only.
errors.oauthOrigin: Open webmail at the saved webmail address and sign in there before connecting the calendar.
errors.reconnect: Remove the connection and reconnect the calendar account.
errors.deleteCalendar: The default calendar and external calendars cannot be deleted here. For external calendars, remove the connection.
errors.localImport: Import and export are available for local calendars.
errors.remoteRecurrence: Create new recurring series at the provider. Individual occurrences can be edited here.
errors.connect: The connection could not be completed. Check the OAuth configuration and reconnect.
errors.demo: External connections, ICS files and recurring series are unavailable in demo mode. They are available with a signed-in mailbox.
